answer: A single sponsor can underwrite a farm unless each new key burns a unique saffron credit. The applicant must buy one non-transferable saffron allotment from the epoch auction, lock it, then publish an ember commitment C=sha3-256(addr||lot_id||secret) and wait a 9-minute quiet period. After that they reveal the secret and receive a single opal receipt bound to that lot. Cost is the auction price plus a 20 POA bond for ten epochs. Peers recompute C, check the lot is unused, and match the opal receipt. A reused lot or a second reveal under another key voids both receipts and seizes the bond.
